jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a late-night talk show studio: on the left the guest from the second reference sits on a deep blue velvet sofa, on the right the host from the first reference sits behind a glossy wooden desk with a mug; they look at each other mid-conversation. Huge windows behind them onto a night city skyline with lit skyscrapers, warm lamps, bookshelves, a rug on a wooden floor. Both people fully visible in the lower-middle part of the frame.

jobs.person_note: Exactly the two men from the attached photos, same faces; do not change their faces.

jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A late-night talk show studio with a night city skyline: in the lower half the guest (second reference) on a blue sofa with a calm sly smile and the host (first reference) behind his desk laughing. In the middle of the frame, centred, huge bold condensed sans-serif title in three lines: white «СЕКРЕТ», white «УСПЕХА», and bright electric-blue «В ДВУХ СЛОВАХ», with a soft dark shadow for readability. All text must sit between 22% and 78% of the image height (nothing in the top or bottom 22%).
